relation.semantics: The 49 values are selected LMAX BBO source pairs. The production USD cross-rate projector resolves each of the 99 PMS security mappings from a direct pair, an inverted direct pair, or two USD legs. Four model runs then consume 72 mapped observations each. Position and market are independent slot inputs joined explicitly in the economic revision input.

transformations.input_contract: completed PMS ingestion, account snapshot, all position snapshots and security mappings
transformations.output_contract: one explicit broker-authority position snapshot selectable at slot start
transformations.input_cardinality: one or more candidate snapshots; 99 selected lines; 99 mappings
transformations.output_cardinality: one position snapshot and 99 current positions
transformations.mapping_authority: persisted security mappings for the selected ingestion
transformations.mapping_sha: computed by arch7b_position_market_slot_lineage_v1 immediately before the live run
transformations.position_snapshot_binding: explicit ID, AsOfUtc, authority and 99-line set SHA
transformations.market_manifest_binding: not present in historical fixtures; mandatory in v1
transformations.revision_binding: source ingestion/session and position snapshot are included in the projection

transformations.input_contract: raw LMAX BBO events, exact slot, 49 required symbols, pre-capture and post-close clock authority
transformations.output_contract: one deterministic selected BBO per required symbol
transformations.mapping_authority: required symbol-to-LMAX-instrument set in the capture manifest
transformations.mapping_sha: required market symbol set SHA plus selection SHA in v1
transformations.slot_session_binding: source timestamp inside the exact slot; bounded late receipt; qualified clocks
transformations.position_snapshot_binding: mandatory external draft evidence in v1
transformations.market_manifest_binding: artifact SHA, selection SHA, clock SHAs and finalized manifest SHA
transformations.revision_binding: consumed by the economic projection builder

transformations.input_contract: fresh LMAX quotes with complete provenance and bounded two-leg skew
transformations.output_contract: direct, inverted-direct, or LMAX_USD_TWO_LEG_CROSS_V1 projected quote
transformations.output_cardinality: one projected quote per requested PMS mapping; 99 total in the builder
transformations.slot_session_binding: source timestamps inherited from the selected LMAX legs
transformations.market_manifest_binding: projection provenance lists exact source legs
transformations.revision_binding: 99 observations are hashed into the revision market SHA

transformations.input_contract: exact slot capture, selected PMS source, 99 mappings and four finalized model runs
transformations.output_contract: one revision with 99 observations, 288 target positions and 288 position-only drifts
transformations.input_cardinality: 49 BBO sources, 99 mappings, 99 current positions, 4 x 72 target weights
transformations.slot_session_binding: capture slot and artifact are explicit revision inputs
transformations.position_snapshot_binding: account snapshot ID, position snapshot ID and position AsOfUtc are explicit revision inputs
transformations.market_manifest_binding: market snapshot ID and SHA are explicit revision inputs; v1 adds selection/manifest evidence
transformations.revision_binding: projection revision ID, input SHA, target SHA, drift SHA and manifest SHA

session_identity_rule.position_source: SourceIngestionId and SourceSessionId identify the PMS source
session_identity_rule.market_source: MarketCaptureSessionId identifies the independent LMAX market-data-only capture
session_identity_rule.join_authority: slot ID/window, selected position evidence, market selection/manifest evidence, mapping-set SHA and economic revision input binding
